description: This source file defines the CounterAggregatorGroup class, which manages a collection of CounterAggregator instances keyed by TagList objects. It provides methods to add measurements with various tag configurations, retrieve or create aggregators for specific tags, and collect the current measurements.

classes.name: CounterAggregatorGroup
classes.description: A class that manages a thread-safe collection of CounterAggregator instances keyed by TagList, providing methods to add measurements and collect results.

methods.name: FindOrCreate
methods.description: Retrieves an existing CounterAggregator for the given TagList or creates a new one if it does not exist.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a measurement with specified tags to the corresponding CounterAggregator.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Collects and returns all non-zero measurements from the managed CounterAggregators.
